purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Panaji

queries.query: site:goa.gov.in Panaji cadastral parcel map land records GIS official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Goa Directorate of Settlement & Land Records, its Panaji office, official Bhunaksha map page, and Goa Online land-record service. The Directorate states it prepares and maintains cadastral survey records and provides city-survey services in Panaji. No anonymous parcel-vector response was found in discovery results.

queries.query: गोवा पणजी भू अभिलेख नकाशा कॅडस्ट्रल अधिकृत
queries.result: Official Goa Konkani-language department material identifies the Settlement and Land Records department, its Panaji address, cadastral/survey-record responsibilities, and online digitally signed Form D service through Goa Online. It did not expose anonymous parcel geometry or a safe native parcel identity.

registryEvidence.custodian: Government of Goa, Directorate of Settlement & Land Records; Inspector of Survey and Land Records, City Survey Panaji.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official Goa department and service-centre pages evidence a local Panaji city-survey custodian and cadastral-record services. They do not establish complete open parcel-geometry coverage for the WUP city extent.

officialSources.observation: Government of Goa says the Directorate prepares and maintains cadastral survey records, offers inspection/certified map services, and has a Panaji office.

Current official Bhunaksha page is a server-rendered WebForms map lookup with Rural/Urban selectors, district/taluka/village/survey/subdivision controls, and a note that the map is informational; no JavaScript map library, public API URL, schema, CRS, or geometry payload was present in the retrieved HTML.

Current official Goa Online land-record page exposes Record of Rights, transaction deed, and property-tax workflows; the retrieved page displayed a notice that Record of Rights and NIC Payment Gateway services were down.

Official land-record page exposes Form I and XIV, Form D, non-promulgated records, maps and property-register navigation, but only interactive form controls/CAPTCHA and no anonymous parcel-vector endpoint.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous response containing both a stable native parcel identity and full polygon geometry was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not used as an absence test.
